name: m2office
description: 中小企業向け AI エージェントシステム

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
